Job Title: Senior SDET
Experience: 5-8 years
Location: Delhi NCR, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
Mandatory Skills:
- Selenium
- Java
- TestNG

Good to have:
- Jenkins
- Postman

Responsibilities:
- Join AegisCore Technologies as a Senior SDET to lead test automation for our customer-facing web and backend services in the payments domain.
- Design, develop and maintain robust, reusable Selenium-based automation frameworks using Java and TestNG to cover functional, regression and smoke test suites.
- Collaborate with product, QA and engineering teams to transform requirements and user stories into automated test cases and ensure test coverage across features.
- Integrate test suites with CI pipelines and build systems; author reliable test execution and reporting processes.
- Debug, triage and report defects with clear steps, logs and automated repro scripts; work with developers to resolve issues and improve product quality.
- Drive test automation best practices, code reviews, and mentorship for junior SDETs; contribute to improving test strategy and metrics.
- Execute API sanity and integration checks using tools like Postman where applicable, and contribute to end-to-end test scenarios.
- Participate in sprint planning, provide testing effort estimates, and ensure timely delivery of automation deliverables.
